text_block_list.text: It's time for the Kokura Kinen, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You know, I went to pray at Dazaifu
Tenmangu
right before the race.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It's where the great scholar Sugawara no

Michizane is enshrined.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
That makes it one of the two most
sacred sites in
Fukuoka, so praying there
should really pay off!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You really don't know? It's so famous,
though...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Well then, I think I have a pretty good
idea on my
hands. If I manage to get
through this race...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Let's go there to celebrate! Hehe! Now
I'm even
more fired up to win!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
